title: Crispy Skillet Chicken Thighs with Lemon-Garlic Pan Sauce
summary: Shatter-crisp skin, juicy meat, and a 3-minute pan sauce from the fond. Sample recipe — delete anytime.
profile: Savory and rich up front from rendered chicken fat and deeply browned skin, cut by bright lemon and a gentle garlic sweetness; thyme and black pepper keep it aromatic rather than herby. Texture contrast is the point: glassy, crackling skin over tender, juicy thigh meat, with a glossy, emulsified butter sauce spooned around (never over) the skin. Delivers 4 servings (6 thighs) in about 45 minutes, mostly hands-off; pairs with rice, crusty bread or a sharp green salad. Leftovers keep 3 days and re-crisp skin-side down in a dry skillet.

steps.text: Pat the thighs very dry and season all over with the salt and pepper. Let them sit uncovered at room temperature for 15 minutes (or up to 24 hours in the fridge for even crisper skin).
steps.tip: Dry skin is crisp skin — moisture steams instead of browns.

steps.text: Add the oil to a cold 12-inch skillet and lay the thighs in skin-side down. Set over medium heat and cook undisturbed until the fat renders and the skin is deep golden and releases on its own, 18–22 minutes. Lower the heat if it smokes hard.
steps.tip: Starting cold renders the fat slowly so the skin thins out and crisps evenly.

steps.text: Flip and cook until the thickest thigh reads 175–185°F near the bone, 8–10 minutes more. Move to a rack or plate skin-side up.
steps.tip: Thighs are tender well past 165°F — the extra heat melts connective tissue.

steps.text: Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat. Add the garlic and thyme over medium-low heat and stir for 1 minute, until fragrant and barely golden.

Add the stock and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Off the heat, add the lemon juice, then swirl in the cold butter a few cubes at a time until glossy. Taste and adjust salt.
steps.tip: Off-heat butter keeps the sauce emulsified instead of greasy.

steps.text: Rest the chicken 5 minutes. Spoon the sauce onto plates and set the thighs on top so the skin stays crisp.
